en: Black‑and‑white image showing a large church with a tall central spire and two smaller flanking spires, each with clocks, rising above a small town. In front of the church are early 20th‑century detached houses and civic buildings on a gentle slope, with a field or reeds in the foreground. The style suggests a northern European townscape.
